_about: Wall-panel wall spec, AP Capital main level: DINING AREA (TM 252234, DWG REV 3 2026-09-30). mm, wall-local: x along the wall from its left end as seen from the room, z up from the SUBFLOOR (survey zero), y = 0 at the wall face, negative toward the room. Geometry: UCON survey = ~/Documents/AP_MF_Dining_Room.skp (probe 820 / 821, 2026-10-19); from TM only the panel numbering. Andriy 2026-10-19: 'as the kitchen' (inside corners as Main Kitchen D: panels 10 short; A / D run through, B / C panels 10 from the A / D panel faces; joints 10 open, panels on the stone 260.35, 10 to the ceiling); window (wall B) as the kitchen windows, the opening opposite (wall C) as the ML Foyer openings; free spans split equally; horizontal joints aligned with the window band where possible. Opening wall opposite the window (TM 3). Option A (Andriy 2026-10-19): piers cut at the room joint 3015.35 / 3025.35 (lower 2755 as TM), the band over the opening from 3054 between the pier tops.
